meta.name: ios-debugger-agent
meta.description: Use XcodeBuildMCP to build, run, launch, and debug the current iOS project on a booted simulator. Trigger when asked to run an iOS app, interact with the simulator UI, inspect on-screen state, capture logs/console output, or diagnose runtime behavior using XcodeBuildMCP tools.

copy.tagline: 在模拟器上构建、运行和调试 iOS 项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Mac 上开发 iOS 应用并需要调试模拟器行为
copy.tagline_en: Build, run, and debug iOS projects on a booted simulator
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop iOS apps on Mac and need to debug simulator behavior

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能构建、运行和调试 iOS 项目，在模拟器上操作界面、查看屏幕状态、抓取日志，并诊断运行时问题。
howto.when: 当你要求运行 iOS 应用、与模拟器界面交互、检查屏幕内容、获取日志或诊断运行时行为时触发。

say.text: 帮我运行当前 iOS 项目并截图。
say.note: Claude 会构建项目、启动模拟器并截图。

say.text: 在模拟器上点击登录按钮。
say.note: Claude 会先描述界面，然后执行点击。

say.text: 抓取模拟器的日志并总结。
say.note: Claude 会启动日志捕获并返回摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can build, run, and debug iOS projects on a booted simulator, interact with the UI, inspect on-screen state, capture logs, and diagnose runtime behavior.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to run an iOS app, interact with the simulator UI, inspect screen content, capture logs, or diagnose runtime behavior.

say_en.text: Run the current iOS project and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will build, launch the simulator, and screenshot.

say_en.text: Tap the login button on the simulator.
say_en.note: Claude will describe the UI first, then tap.
Claude will start log capture and return a summary.
